select moi.id, moi.order_id, mo.order_no, mo.platform_code, mo.platform_name, moi.phone, moi.process_status, moi.process_result, moi.process_note, moi.processed_by, moi.processed_time, moi.create_by, moi.create_time, moi.update_by, moi.update_time, moi.remark, su.user_name as user_name, su.nick_name as nick_name, mo.remark as order_remark from mark_order_item moi inner join mark_order mo on mo.id = moi.order_id left join sys_user su on su.user_id = mo.user_id
and mo.audit_status = '1'
and not exists ( select 1 from mark_agent_hidden_user mahu where mahu.agent_user_id = #{agentId} and mahu.hidden_user_id = mo.user_id )
and mo.user_id = #{query.userId}
and su.user_name like concat('%', #{query.userName}, '%')
and moi.phone like concat('%', #{query.phone}, '%')
and moi.process_status = #{query.processStatus}
and ( ( moi.process_status = '0' and lower(mo.platform_code) not in ('tengxun', 'tencent', 'tx', 'txwz') ) or ( moi.process_status = '3' and lower(mo.platform_code) in ('td_gaopin') ) )
and ( ( moi.process_status = '3' and lower(mo.platform_code) not in ('td_gaopin') ) or ( moi.process_status = '0' and lower(mo.platform_code) in ('tengxun', 'tencent', 'tx', 'txwz') ) )
and moi.process_status in ('1', '2')
and mo.platform_code = #{query.platformCode}
and find_in_set(mo.platform_code, #{query.platformCodes})
and ( (moi.processed_time is not null and moi.processed_time >= #{query.params.beginTime}) or (moi.processed_time is null and moi.create_time >= #{query.params.beginTime}) )
and moi.create_time >= #{query.params.beginTime}
and ( (moi.processed_time is not null and moi.processed_time <= concat(#{query.params.endTime}, ' 23:59:59')) or (moi.processed_time is null and moi.create_time <= concat(#{query.params.endTime}, ' 23:59:59')) )
and moi.create_time <= concat(#{query.params.endTime}, ' 23:59:59')
order by moi.create_time desc, moi.id desc

select distinct su.user_id as userId, su.user_name as userName, su.nick_name as nickName, case when mahu.hidden_user_id is null then false else true end as hidden from mark_order mo inner join sys_user su on su.user_id = mo.user_id left join mark_agent_hidden_user mahu on mahu.agent_user_id = #{agentId} and mahu.hidden_user_id = mo.user_id where mo.audit_status = '1'
order by su.user_name asc
mapper.insert: insert into mark_agent_hidden_user (agent_user_id, hidden_user_id, create_by, create_time) values (#{agentId}, #{userId}, #{createBy}, now()) on duplicate key update create_by = values(create_by), create_time = values(create_time)
mapper.delete: delete from mark_agent_hidden_user where agent_user_id = #{agentId} and hidden_user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select:
select daily.stat_date, daily.user_id, daily.user_name, daily.nick_name, count(*) as platform_count, sum(daily.order_count) as order_count, sum(daily.item_count) as item_count, sum(daily.success_count) as success_count, sum(daily.failed_count) as failed_count, sum(daily.processing_count) as processing_count, sum(daily.pending_count) as pending_count, max(daily.last_processed_time) as last_processed_time, json_arrayagg(json_object( 'platformCode', daily.platform_code, 'platformName', daily.platform_name, 'orderCount', daily.order_count, 'itemCount', daily.item_count, 'successCount', daily.success_count, 'failedCount', daily.failed_count, 'processingCount', daily.processing_count, 'pendingCount', daily.pending_count, 'lastProcessedTime', date_format(daily.last_processed_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') )) as platform_summary_json from ( select date(coalesce(moi.processed_time, moi.create_time)) as stat_date, mo.user_id, su.user_name, su.nick_name, mo.platform_code, coalesce(nullif(max(mo.platform_name), ''), mo.platform_code) as platform_name, count(distinct mo.id) as order_count, count(*) as item_count, sum(case when moi.process_status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as success_count, sum(case when moi.process_status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as failed_count, sum(case when moi.process_status = '3' and lower(mo.platform_code) != 'td_gaopin' then 1 when moi.process_status = '0' and lower(mo.platform_code) in ('tengxun', 'tencent', 'tx', 'txwz') then 1 else 0 end) as processing_count, sum(case when moi.process_status = '0' and lower(mo.platform_code) not in ('tengxun', 'tencent', 'tx', 'txwz') then 1 when moi.process_status = '3' and lower(mo.platform_code) = 'td_gaopin' then 1 else 0 end) as pending_count, max(coalesce(moi.processed_time, moi.create_time)) as last_processed_time from mark_order_item moi inner join mark_order mo on mo.id = moi.order_id left join sys_user su on su.user_id = mo.user_id
and mo.audit_status = '1'
and mo.user_id = #{query.userId}
and mo.platform_code = #{query.platformCode}
and ( (moi.processed_time is not null and moi.processed_time >= #{query.params.beginTime}) or (moi.processed_time is null and moi.create_time >= #{query.params.beginTime}) )
and ( (moi.processed_time is not null and moi.processed_time <= concat(#{query.params.endTime}, ' 23:59:59')) or (moi.processed_time is null and moi.create_time <= concat(#{query.params.endTime}, ' 23:59:59')) )
group by date(coalesce(moi.processed_time, moi.create_time)), mo.user_id, su.user_name, su.nick_name, mo.platform_code ) daily group by daily.stat_date, daily.user_id, daily.user_name, daily.nick_name order by daily.stat_date desc, daily.user_name asc, daily.user_id asc

inner join mark_order mo on mo.id = moi.order_id inner join mark_platform_mapping mpm on lower(mpm.source_platform_code) = lower(mo.platform_code) and lower(mpm.target_platform_code) = 'td_gaopin' and mpm.source_enabled = '0' and mpm.target_enabled = '0' and mpm.mapping_enabled = '0' where moi.process_status = '0' and mo.audit_status = '1' order by moi.update_time asc, moi.id asc limit #{limit}

inner join mark_order mo on mo.id = moi.order_id where ( moi.process_status = '0' or (lower(#{platformCode}) = 'xiaomi' and moi.process_status = '3') ) and mo.audit_status = '1' and lower(mo.platform_code) = lower(#{platformCode}) order by coalesce(moi.update_time, moi.create_time) asc, moi.id asc limit #{limit}

inner join mark_order mo on mo.id = moi.order_id where moi.process_status = '3' and mo.audit_status = '1' and lower(mo.platform_code) = 'td_second' and coalesce(moi.update_time, moi.create_time) <= date_sub(now(), interval #{checkIntervalMinutes} minute) order by coalesce(moi.update_time, moi.create_time) asc, moi.id asc limit #{limit}

select moi.process_note from mark_order_item moi inner join mark_order mo on mo.id = moi.order_id where mo.user_id = #{userId} and lower(mo.platform_code) = 'td_second' and moi.phone = #{phone} and moi.process_status = '2' and moi.process_note is not null and moi.process_note like '%taskId=%' order by moi.id desc
